title: 第7章 密谋偷窃作大死-《开局三预言？我直播通关S级末世》
content:
第(1/3)页

    靳氏集团在A市崛起的时间差不多有二十年左右，不算什么老牌大企业，但是也绝不是什么无名之辈。

    老板靳建国从公司出名之后，生意一帆风顺，看上去的确就是一个中年有为的企业家而已。

    谢辞看过所有资料，唯一的疑点就是靳氏集团崛起的时间，正好就是靳兰玦出生没多久之后。

    联想靳兰玦在直播时提到，家人盗取她气运这件事，靳家能如此一帆风顺的真相倒真是有点耐人寻味。

    但是除此之外，靳家人并没有什么其他可疑的地方。

    靳建国是个爱吹牛的左右逢源的商人，传闻对员工很暴躁。

    何秀芳是个很爱慕虚荣的老板娘，喜欢各种奢侈品大牌，没什么文化，太太圈子都不太喜欢她。

    靳泽宇就是个好色的二世祖，整天游手好闲，欺男霸女无恶不做，近些年还染上了赌博。

    靳家还有个小儿子，但是据说身体不好，从小就送进山里养着，没什么信息。

    谢辞看过一圈，还是将目光放在靳兰玦身上。

    他仔细研究了网上所有的录屏，发现靳兰玦第二卦一开始的内容，是关于自己哥哥靳泽宇的。

    但最新的补充内容，却说化工厂会爆炸。

    说明，靳泽宇和化工厂爆炸之间，一定有什么联系。

    于是谢辞查到靳泽宇的行踪，打算先一探究竟。

    哪知，他正坐在烟熏火燎的油腻小凳子上偷听隔壁目标的交谈，面前就大喇喇坐下来一个人。

    谢辞不悦抬眼，就看到靳兰玦嚼着臭豆腐放下手里一堆小吃，还往绿植那边贴贴，似乎是听清楚那边在说什么。

    然后，两人四目相对，谢辞在对方的眼中看到了迷茫后的震惊。

    谢辞双眼微眯，心底浮起异样的感受。

    看到自己后，她为什么会震惊？

    一般来说，突然发现坐在了有人的桌子上，第一反应应该是抱歉吧？

    靳兰玦认出眼前的人，就是上一世救过她的那位国家队大佬。

    只是这位大佬目前的头发还是黑色的。

    她的目光不由落在对方的头发上，唔……

    黑发也别有一番帅气。

    眼看对面的男人拧着眉头要说话，她的耳朵里捕捉到靳泽宇的声音，连忙竖起食指：

    “嘘。”
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The Jin Group has been around in City A for about twenty years. It is not a big old company, but it is by no means an unknown person.

Since the boss Jin Jianguo became famous in the company, his business has been going smoothly. He seems to be just a middle-aged and promising entrepreneur.

Xie Ci has read all the information, and the only doubt is that the rise of the Jin Group happened to be not long after Jin Lanjue was born.

Lenovo Jin Lanjue mentioned during the live broadcast that her family had stolen her luck. The truth about the Jin family's smooth sailing is really intriguing.

But other than that, there is nothing suspicious about the Jin family.

Jin Jianguo is a bragging and arrogant businessman who is rumored to be very irritable with his employees.

He Xiufang is a very vain boss lady who likes all kinds of luxury brands. She has no culture and the circle of wives doesn't like her very much.

Jin Zeyu is a lustful second-generation ancestor who idles around all day long, bullies men and dominates women, and does all kinds of evil. In recent years, he has even gotten into gambling.

The Jin family also has a younger son, but it is said that he is in poor health and has been raised in the mountains since he was a child. There is no information about him.

Xie Ci looked around, but still focused on Jin Lanjue.

He carefully studied all the screen recordings on the Internet and found that the content at the beginning of Jin Lanjue’s second hexagram was about his brother Jin Zeyu.

But the latest supplementary content says that chemical plants will explode.

It shows that there must be some connection between Jin Zeyu and the explosion in the chemical plant.

So Xie Ci found out Jin Zeyu’s whereabouts and planned to find out first.

Unexpectedly, he was sitting on a smoky and greasy stool, eavesdropping on the conversation of the target next door, and a man sat down in front of him.

谢辞不悦抬眼，就看到靳兰玦嚼着臭豆腐放下手里一堆小吃，还往绿植那边贴贴，似乎是听清楚那边在说什么。

Then, the two looked at each other, and Xie Ci saw the confusion and shock in the other's eyes.

Xie Ci narrowed his eyes slightly and felt a strange feeling in his heart.

Why was she shocked after seeing herself?

Generally speaking, when you suddenly find yourself sitting at an occupied table, your first reaction should be to apologize, right?

Jin Lanjue recognized the person in front of her as the national team boss who had saved her in her previous life.

It’s just that this big guy’s hair is still black.

Her eyes couldn’t help but fall on the other person’s hair, well...

Black hair is also very handsome.

Seeing that the man opposite was frowning and about to speak, her ears caught Jin Zeyu's voice and she quickly raised her index finger:

"Shhh."
